scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Are you going to enter the ^0000FFDimensional Gap^000000?  Please use this Transport Device you see here.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
您打算進入^0000FF次元裂縫^000000嗎？
請使用這裡的傳送裝置。

scripts.text: What is the Dimensional Gap?
scripts.translation: 什麼是次元裂縫？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
As you know we've already entered through the Dimensional Rift to get to Ash Vacuum right?  The Dimensional Gap is an expansion of that initial discovery.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
如您所知，我們之前是通過次元裂縫進入阿什真空的，對吧？
次元裂縫就是基於那次發現的擴充套件。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
A member of the Expedition team found these backdoor passages to get through the Dimensional Rifts.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
遠征隊的一名成員發現了穿越次元裂縫的捷徑。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
This is like a Midgard Alliance version of the Bifrost bridge so it can connect us to different parts of the New World.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
這就像是米德加爾特聯盟版的比弗羅斯特橋，可以將我們連線到新世界的不同區域。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Time and space is distorted in the Dimensional Gap.  Not all passageways have been discovered so please be sure to use caution when entering an unverified area.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
次元裂縫中的時空是扭曲的。
並非所有通道都已被發現，進入未驗證區域時請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Anyone who has become lost here has yet to return.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
在這裡迷路的人至今都未歸來。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
請多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Guide]
Please use a ^0000FFTransport Device^000000 if you wish to travel through the dimensional rift.  The insides have not been fully explored yet so please be careful in there.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊嚮導]
如果您想穿越次元裂縫，請使用^0000FF傳送裝置^000000。
內部尚未完全探索，請在其中保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the Allied Forces ^0000FFExpedition Camp^000000 in Jotunheim.
scripts.translation:
[聯合軍士兵]
這條次元裂縫連線著約頓海姆的聯合軍^0000FF遠征營地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Allied Forces Soldier]
Do not worry, it has been set up after testing hundreds of experiments for safe teleportation.
scripts.translation:
[聯合軍士兵]
別擔心，我們經過數百次實驗測試，確保了瞬間移動的安全性。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to ^0000FFMorocc^000000 back in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克士兵]
這條次元裂縫連線著米德加爾特後方的^0000FF夢羅克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Morocc Soldier]
This is the fastest gateway back to our world.  The area is still destroyed but restoration efforts will soon be on the way.
scripts.translation:
[夢羅克士兵]
這是返回我們世界最快的通道。
雖然該區域仍處於破壞狀態，但重建工作很快就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
This dimensional rift is connected to the south of ^0000FFBifrost^000000.  It enables quick travel to the Splendide frontline.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域士兵]
這條次元裂縫連線著^0000FF比弗羅斯特^000000的南部。
它可以讓我們快速前往輝煌領域的前線。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
If we use it properly, it enables us to advance more easily to the capital of the Sapha.
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域士兵]
如果善加利用，它能讓我們更輕鬆地推進到薩法的首都。

scripts.text:
[Spledide Soldier]
The Mayor has asked us to cooperate as best we can instead of fighting, so I'm under orders not to do anything.  Since we have a common enemy we won't fight the Sapha... for now...
scripts.translation:
[輝煌領域士兵]
市長要求我們儘可能合作而非戰鬥，所以我接到了不得采取行動的命令。
既然我們有共同的敵人，我們就不會攻擊薩法...暫時不會...

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
This dimensional rift is connected to the southern area of the ^0000FFKamidal Mountains^000000 in El Dicastes.  I just dropped by for my research, but it is incredible.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的薩法族]
這條次元裂縫連線著埃爾迪卡特斯^0000FF卡米達爾山脈^000000的南部區域。
我只是順路來做研究，但這簡直令人難以置信。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Sapha]
Moreover it is next to the Laphine capital..... Hmm... Do not worry, I do not want to fight in such a place.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的薩法族]
而且它就在拉菲涅首都旁邊.....嗯...別擔心，我不想在這樣的地方戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Welcome.  I am in charge of logistics to take care of your items in this weird place.  Do you need to access your storage?
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
歡迎光臨。
我負責在這個奇怪的地方管理您的物品後勤。
您需要訪問倉庫嗎？

scripts.text: Open Storage 200 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 開啟倉庫 200 Zeny

scripts.text: No Thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You are not yet qualified to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
您還不符合使用倉庫的條件。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
You need at least 200 zeny to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
使用倉庫至少需要200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Logistics Manager]
Let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[後勤主管]
如果您改變主意了，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Who're you?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What do you want?
You looking something in
particular?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你想幹什麼？
你在找什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
So some enforcers have been
cracking down on merchants lately.
I can not sell anything.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
最近有些執法者在查抄商人。
我什麼都賣不了。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Come here...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
過來一下...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I knew you would be here!!
No illegal trading is allowed
here!
Don't you know?
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
我就知道你會在這裡！！
這裡禁止非法交易！
你不知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
誰規定的？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Ok, then show me your permit.
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
好吧，那就出示一下你的許可證。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Permit?
No one's in charge here!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
許可證？
這裡沒人管！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You! If you need anything come to
me ok?
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
喂！如果你需要什麼，來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
I will catch you!
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
我會抓住你的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Cold juice!
Apple, grape, orange~
Anything you want!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
冰果汁！
蘋果、葡萄、橙子~
想要什麼都有！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Sweet potato, dumpling~
Here we have delicious desserts~
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
紅薯、餃子~
這裡還有美味的甜點~

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You need to pay a toll to get past here.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你要通過這裡，得交過路費。

scripts.text: What toll?
scripts.translation: 什麼過路費？

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You did not know?
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你不知道嗎？
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
You there!
Stop right there!
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
喂！
站住！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Ugh! How are you always following me?
Got some kind of crush on me or something? I don't think you and I make a good match...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
嘖！你為什麼總是跟著我？
該不會是迷戀我吧？我覺得我們倆並不般配...

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Why don't we find out then?
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
那我們去找找看吧。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
That's it no more talking.
I'm outta here~
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
好了，不說了。
我走了~

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Keep running you sneaky coward!
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
跑什麼跑，你這個膽小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
500 zeny
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
You are lucky that you have met up
with me.
Who am I?
I'm here to become a merchant
King.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你能遇到我，真是幸運。
我是誰呢？
我是立志成為商人國王的王子。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I might be working a street stall
now but I'll have an actual shop
some day.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
我現在雖然是在擺地攤，
但總有一天我會擁有真正的店鋪。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
It's my first day so I'm having a
major sale.
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
今天是開業第一天，所以有大促銷。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Let's see I've got a...
Ring of something!
Sword of stuff!
A backpack of some sort!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
讓我看看，我有...
某種戒指！
某把劍！
還有某種背包！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
Tell me if you need anything,
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
如果你需要什麼，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
What are you doing here?
This is my spot for a shop
Get outta my turf!
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
你在這裡做什麼？
這是我的攤位。
滾出我的地盤！

scripts.text:
[Jumpy Knight]
Bah!!
You're gonna regret those words!
scripts.translation:
[神經緊張的騎士]
哼！！
你會後悔說這種話的！

scripts.text:
[Prince Canet]
I'm shaking...
scripts.translation:
[王子 卡內特]
我在發抖...

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
The Royal Guard in here
was desperate for help.
We entered through a secret place
in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的騎士]
這裡的皇家衛士急需援助。
我們是通過宮殿裡的秘密通道進來的。

scripts.text:
[Curious Knight]
We were whisked away here...
No idea where I am but I have to
establish a base here for the
Knighthood.
scripts.translation:
[好奇的騎士]
我們被傳送到了這裡...
不知道這是哪裡，但我必須在這裡建立騎士團的據點。

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
One minute I'm in a bar...
The next minute I'm here...
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盜賊]
前一秒我還在酒吧...
下一秒我就在這裡了...
這是什麼地方？

scripts.text:
[Confused Thief]
There's no night or day in here.
Hmm, something has to be valuable
in this place...
scripts.translation:
[困惑的盜賊]
這裡沒有白天和黑夜之分。
嗯，這個地方一定有什麼值錢的東西...

scripts.text:
[Adventurous Rafflesia]
No no this has to be Thanatos
Tower...
I sense dark magic here.
scripts.translation:
[愛冒險的大王花]
不不，這應該是塔納托斯之塔...
我感覺到這裡有黑暗魔法。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Oh, we're back here again.
I cannot find a way out!
We are trapped in this maze!
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
哎呀，我們又回到這裡了。
我找不到出口！
我們被困在這個迷宮裡了！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Is this place the famous Prontera?
It is dark just like a big city!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
這裡是著名的普隆德拉嗎？
這裡很暗，就像一座大城市一樣！

scripts.text:
[Traveller]
I hear a ticking clock.
This place must be Geffen!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我聽到了時鐘滴答的聲音。
這裡一定是吉芬！
